interpreted_intent: The user asks for fresh concepts that properly realize the seductive direction, as clarified by the earlier complaint that the old topics were ordinary tasks with attractive faces. This arm authors a playful attention-catching invitation at a jazz-salon threshold: the viewer is the target of gaze and a beckoning gesture during an interrupted turn. The doorway, wink, finger curl, late-twenties adult portrayal, red silk dress, and warm/cool lighting are agent choices, not human scene prescriptions. The supplied portrait informs only visible face and hair; it establishes no biography, body, age, personality or actual desire. The whole photograph should read as knowingly flirtatious before its supporting nightlife setting is noticed. Sensual=3 and fetish=0 are coordinator-selected experimental controls, not human numeric settings.
subject: An authored adult woman with the supplied portrait used for visible face and hair only
setting: Velvet-curtained balcony doorway of a late-night Art Deco jazz salon
event: A deliberately flirtatious invitation addressed to the viewer as she interrupts a turn into the salon
visual_priorities: The open eye, wink and one-sided knowing smile address the viewer as one playful attention-catching expression.
One palm-up index-finger curl clearly beckons the viewer while the other hand parts the velvet curtain.
Her body begins to turn into the warm room while her face and gesture return to the viewer, suspending the invitation at the threshold.
The red silk dress and amber/cool-blue light support the seductive moment without taking priority over her expression and hand.
baseline_prompt_en: A vertical photograph of an adult woman in her late twenties making a playful seductive bid for the viewer's attention at the velvet-curtained balcony entrance of a late-night Art Deco jazz salon. Her visible face and dark bob with wispy bangs follow the supplied portrait. Her gaze and gesture combine into a deliberately flirtatious invitation addressed to the viewer. She closes her right eye in a deliberate wink; her open left eye meets the camera. A knowing smile lifts one corner of her lips. Her left hand reaches forward at chest height, palm up, with the index finger curling toward herself in a clear come-closer gesture. Her right hand gathers the plum velvet curtain at shoulder height, keeping the opening clear beside her. Her weight rests on the leg nearest the salon, with her shoulders half-turned into the doorway and her face returned to the viewer. She wears a deep-red silk halter mini dress, its softly draped neckline and bare shoulders catching a warm edge of light. Amber salon light brushes her cheek and the curtain folds; cool blue balcony light defines the opposite edge. The room behind her resolves into an amber pool of light and a few blurred brass architectural lines. Frame her from above the knees to just above her head, with both hands fully visible. A natural eye-level 50 mm perspective keeps her face, inviting hand and interrupted turn equally legible, with tangible silk, velvet and natural skin texture.
